name: Power Electronic Converters for Renewable Energy Systems
description: Current status and future developments in renewable energy. Requirements for solar and wind power generation from the grid including relevant standards, Solar Power – PV system configurations, Solar cell technologies, Maximum power point tracking, Photovoltaic Inverters different types of topologies and control strategies. Single phase PV converters. Wind power – Wind power energy system, types of wind turbines- fixed speed and variable speed, different types of converters – AC-DC-AC converters, multilevel converter etc. Different control techniques of converters. Green hydrogen based fuel cells and battery energy storage systems. Grid synchronization and PLL, Grid regulations. Islanding operation. Control of converters for fault operation. Grid forming converters.
